- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Lines 233-234 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: P1 specifies `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only`, but `--name-only` is not a valid `git merge-tree` option.
  WHY: The command fails with an unrecognized-flag error, so an implementer may queue the PR even when no real conflict exists.
- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Line 353 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: P10 treats Compare API status `behind` for `GET compare/<merge_sha>...stable` as proof that `stable` contains the merge commit.
  WHY: `behind` means `stable` is behind the merge SHA, so the operator step could be completed before release containment; reviewers disagreed on severity, with the highest rating being BLOCKER.
- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Lines 234-240 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The head-age cap only treats blockers with specified labels as stale, although G1 says an over-age train head stops blocking.
  WHY: An old blocking PR without those labels can continue blocking beyond `MERGE_TRAIN_HEAD_MAX_AGE_HOURS`.
- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Lines 154, 234-239 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The rollback instruction says `MERGE_TRAIN_HEAD_MAX_AGE_HOURS=0` restores current behavior without defining zero as disabling the age rule.
  WHY: Under the specified “older than the cap” check, labeled blockers older than zero hours become stale immediately, enabling bypass instead of restoring current behavior.
- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Lines 263-269 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: P3 counts `AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1` markers from issue comments without requiring that they were posted by a trusted workflow account.
  WHY: A user can forge repeated markers to trigger failure labels and stop retries without genuine LLM failures; reviewers disagreed on severity, with the highest rating being BLOCKER.
- docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md:Lines 310-315 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: P6 persists `parked=true` and skips future scans without defining retry or compensation if the digest upsert or Telegram delivery fails.
  WHY: A delivery failure after parking leaves the item without the required human notice and with no specified path to retry.

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The referenced Phase 4a/4b design handles WAITING targets of kind PR or release; P8 adds security-dependency handling, but neither specifies polling, resuming, or escalating generic issue-number prerequisites.
